apps.name: Dusklight
apps.subtitle: A native port of a classic adventure
apps.localizedDescription: Dusklight brings a classic adventure natively to the iPhone and iPad with modern rendering, flexible controls and quality-of-life options. You must provide a dump of your own copy of the original game to play.

versions.localizedDescription:
**What's new:**

* **Added:** New InterpService: Provides interpolation for custom model rendering. ([#2636](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/pull/2636))
* **Added:** GfxService v1.4: Provides backing textures for resolved framebuffers. ([#2643](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/pull/2643), [Aurora #260](https://github.com/encounter/aurora/pull/260))
* **Fixed:** Vulkan startup crash on Android devices with Adreno GPUs, including the Galaxy S23 and Odin 2. ([Aurora `bded88e95d`](https://github.com/encounter/aurora/commit/bded88e95d5a1a7c8b2d747843cb8cde17b39838), [#2563](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/issues/2563))
* **Fixed:** HTTPS requests failing in Linux AppImage builds because system CA certificates weren't found. ([Borealis `4ac5e7052a`](https://github.com/encounter/borealis/commit/4ac5e7052a8c49a122f8d57f626b5c75c5ca6968))
* **Fixed:** WebSocket service being unavailable in Linux AppImage builds. ([`40457c6adb`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/40457c6adb381928e4b5fef6ed459ed291edd5e2), [Borealis `4ac5e7052a`](https://github.com/encounter/borealis/commit/4ac5e7052a8c49a122f8d57f626b5c75c5ca6968))
* **Fixed:** False memory card corruption errors after resetting and switching game modes. ([`7b60dc8f24`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/7b60dc8f24c03656ca69d51cacec84832df9e227))
* **Fixed:** Incorrect camera framing in the cutscene before Goron Mines. ([#2648](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/pull/2648), [#956](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/issues/956))
* **Fixed:** Crashes and missing fire when retrying the burning house sequence in Kakariko Village after dying. ([#2649](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/pull/2649), [#1441](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/issues/1441))
* **Changed:** Significantly improved Mod Manager performance, especially with a large number of mods. ([`ceda410434`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/ceda410434286107741eb43c7e3ade914c5f1751), [`eb5ad19dbc`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/eb5ad19dbc488345163f0c076911fb38368cf115))
* **Changed:** Significantly improved Logs window performance. ([`55e2904ce0`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/55e2904ce03548348021ec0137616e5d65683982))
* **Changed:** Updated bundled Dusklight Randomizer to v1.0.6. ([`b9c370d5d1`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/commit/b9c370d5d1851b83040e8c767cbbbce8e580185b))
  * Fixed entrance randomizer logic incorrectly treating human and wolf abilities as interchangeable in Twilight. ([Randomizer `cfa99c1944`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/cfa99c1944f36c4285923be65cbda6916a31ff15))
  * Fixed some logical areas not taking into account that you could change time of day with Midna. ([Randomizer `cfa99c1944`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/cfa99c1944f36c4285923be65cbda6916a31ff15))
  * Fixed boss exits when dungeon entrances are shuffled but boss entrances are not. ([Randomizer `6f650ca077`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/6f650ca0771375ca3a09679d99d9e60c48b5a59a))
  * Fixed inaccessible doors in Kakariko Twilight before obtaining the village's warp portal, which could cause entrance randomizer softlocks. ([Randomizer `12d7cf807a`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/12d7cf807a325da71e264d9e2dd36d4ff09103b7))
  * Fixed music staying muted after entering a shuffled boss room through the Forest Temple boss door. ([Randomizer `ee58b04d21`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/ee58b04d21cd413da2607e8fc79e2521d7bc6764), [Randomizer #85](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/issues/85))
  * Fixed the map not appearing after howling at the Snowpeak Howling Stone. ([Randomizer `2d97aa9a6c`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/2d97aa9a6c68e85a51b2a80aabce26d6228a1fbc))
  * Prevented starting the broken goat-catching sequence with Bo in Ordon Village. ([Randomizer `4f5bb4e14d`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/4f5bb4e14d76037981ea83fad384d98545f9c337))
  * Fixed some item checks in Ordon Village and south of Castle Town in alternate story states. ([Randomizer `4f5bb4e14d`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/4f5bb4e14d76037981ea83fad384d98545f9c337), [`e8d2c020c2`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/e8d2c020c27cdbd754a0a5aea8ea4b27335b9d1d))
  * Corrected the logic connection between Snowpeak Ruins' double Freezard room and the west courtyard balcony. ([Randomizer `325fcf9358`](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight-randomizer/commit/325fcf9358adc41ab56f65b27be79e8eb5721442))
